AV-01.title: Antivirus Real-Time Protection
AV-01.description: Scans files and running processes in real-time against malware.

AV-02.title: Cloud-Based Threat Detection (MAPS)
AV-02.description: Analyzes unknown zero-day threats via the Microsoft Cloud protection network.
AV-02.remediation:
Run with Administrator PowerShell:
Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting Advanced

AV-03.title: Tamper Protection
AV-03.description: Prevents malware from modifying security settings (antivirus, firewall).
AV-03.remediation: Windows Security > Virus & Threat Protection > Manage Settings > Turn on Tamper Protection.

AV-04.title: PUA/PUP Protection
AV-04.description: Blocks potentially unwanted applications that slow down the system.
AV-04.remediation:
Run with Administrator PowerShell:
Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled

AV-05.title: Controlled Folder Access (Ransomware Protection)
AV-05.description: Prevents unauthorized encryption of critical folders like Documents and Pictures by ransomware.
AV-05.remediation:
Run with Administrator PowerShell:
Set-MpPreference -EnableControlledFolderAccess Enabled

AV-06.title: Virus & Security Intelligence Definition Freshness
AV-06.description: Checks if Microsoft Defender virus and threat definitions are up to date.
AV-06.remediation:
Update definitions immediately via Admin PowerShell:
Update-MpSignature

AV-07.title: Detected Antivirus / Security Products
AV-07.description: Lists registered security software on the system.

AV-08.title: Defender ASR Rules
AV-08.description: Prevents LSASS memory dumping, executing malicious macros from Office, etc.
AV-08.remediation:
Enable LSASS protection rule via PowerShell:
Add-MpPreference -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 -AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions Enabled

NET-01.title: Externally Listening Ports
NET-01.description: Audits services listening on 0.0.0.0 and :: for external connections.
NET-01.remediation: Stop unnecessary services or block incoming connections via Windows Firewall.

NET-02.title: SMBv1 Protocol (EternalBlue / WannaCry Risk)
NET-02.description: SMBv1 is a legacy protocol; it's the propagation vector for ransomware like EternalBlue and WannaCry.
NET-02.remediation:
Disable immediately via Admin PowerShell:
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol -NoRestart

NET-03.title: LLMNR Protocol (NTLM Hash Theft Risk)
NET-03.description: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution can be spoofed by attackers (Responder) to steal NTLMv2 hashes.
NET-03.remediation:
Disable via Admin PowerShell:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -Name 'EnableMulticast' -Value 0 -Type DWord

NET-04.title: NetBIOS over TCP/IP Broadcast
NET-04.description: Legacy NetBIOS broadcasts allow attackers to spoof name queries on the local network.
NET-04.remediation: Network Adapter Properties > IPv4 > Advanced > WINS > Check 'Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP'.

NET-05.title: Remote Desktop (RDP) & NLA Security
NET-05.description: If RDP is enabled without Network Level Authentication (NLA), it is vulnerable to pre-auth attacks like BlueKeep.
NET-05.remediation:
Enforce NLA via Admin PowerShell:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -Name 'UserAuthentication' -Value 1 -Type DWord

NET-06.title: Saved Wireless Network (Wi-Fi) Profiles
NET-06.description: Checks if the system has any saved open or unencrypted Wi-Fi profiles which can lead to Evil Twin attacks.

NET-07.title: SMB Packet Signing (SMB Signing Mandatory)
NET-07.description: Enforcing SMB signing prevents NTLM Relay and Man-in-the-Middle attacks.
NET-07.remediation:
Enforce SMB signing via PowerShell:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' -Name 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Value 1 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters' -Name 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Value 1 -Type DWord

UPD-04.title: 3rd Party Software and Application Update Audit
UPD-04.description: Scans for outdated third-party applications (browsers, runtimes, utilities) which could lead to exploitation.

UPD-05.title: Pending Windows & Defender Updates
UPD-05.description: Checks if there are critical OS or security patches pending installation.
